verdict.rationale: Angular's component model with signals-based fine-grained local state (angular-docs-1, angular-docs-2) directly enables encapsulated components composed into complex UIs, and community reports corroborate genuine encapsulation and reusability without dependency hell (angular-comm-2), plus large real-world apps built via component/directive composition (angular-comm-12). missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically on component composition patterns, and more recent (post-Signals) community validation rather than older AngularJS-era commentary.
